headline: Onyxia in 4:03 with no deaths and no world buffs

also.text: the most healing, 51k, and 3 Flame Lashes dispelled

overview: One pull, 4:03 against a usual 4:26, no deaths, with one raider carrying world buffs. Fears hit 1.2 per raider against a usual 2.6, and lava cracks half as often as usual.

wentWell.text: No deaths, and fears and lava cracks at about half the usual rate.

notes.text: 4:03 (median 4:26), no deaths. Wizness parse 97, Zimligemein 95, Alanakos 92.
Lava cracks hit 12 raiders 14 times; Künigünde and Smolsister took 2 each.
